research_metadata.task_context: Tauri v2 multiplatform ASCII-renderer application (macOS, Windows, Android) with Docker-like sandbox isolation, high-performance ASCII rendering engines (Wasm/Rust/WebGL/WebGPU)

recommended_color_system.rationale: Terminal/hacker aesthetic aligns with ASCII art identity. Green-on-black is canonical. Pink accent for interactive elements.

recommended_typography.rationale: Monospace fonts are non-negotiable for ASCII grid alignment. JetBrains Mono has excellent ligature support and clear character distinction.

design_signals.recommended_animation_approach: requestAnimationFrame loop with adaptive frame budget. Single orchestrated moment: ASCII character reveal on load. WebGL/WebGPU shader for real-time image-to-ASCII conversion.
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Canvas 2D fillText for large grids (use WebGL texture atlas instead)
Synchronous image processing on UI thread (use Web Worker or Rust sidecar)
Fixed character set (use dynamic luminance mapping)
No frame throttling (always use requestAnimationFrame with delta time)

framework.rationale: Smallest binary size, native Rust backend, ACL-based security, multiplatform (macOS, Windows, Android, iOS)

frontend.rationale: Best Tauri ecosystem support, mature tooling, WebGPU/WebGL library compatibility

tier1_webgpu.rationale: GPU-accelerated ASCII conversion. basementstudio/shader-lab and DavidHDev/canvas-ui prove this pattern works.

tier2_webgl.rationale: Fallback for devices without WebGPU. pixijs/filters AsciiFilter is battle-tested.

tier3_canvas.rationale: Maximum compatibility. Use only for static images or low-res previews.

rust_backend.reasoning: CPU-bound image processing offloaded to Rust sidecar. Avoids blocking WebView JS thread.

animation.rationale: No heavy animation library needed. ASCII art is inherently frame-based.

state.rationale: Lightweight, no boilerplate, works well with Tauri IPC

ui_primitives.rationale: Accessible primitives, fully skinnable with terminal aesthetic

recommended_templates.name: Cruip
recommended_templates.rationale: Clean dark templates adaptable to ASCII aesthetic

recommended_templates.name: HTML5 UP
recommended_templates.rationale: Responsive dark themes, minimal customization needed

ascii_specific: DavidHDev/canvas-ui AsciifyWebGPU - DOM to ASCII capture
basementstudio/shader-lab ascii-pass - Three.js WebGPU ASCII shader

multiplatform.android: Android WebView, requires ANDROID_HOME + NDK_HOME, tauri android init && tauri android build --apk

sandbox_isolation.csp: Content Security Policy in tauri.conf.json - restricts WebView sources
sandbox_isolation.ipc_enforcement: Every plugin command checked against RuntimeAuthority ACL
sandbox_isolation.sidecar_isolation: External binaries via shell plugin with permission-scoped execution
sandbox_isolation.scope_validation: Parameter validation for Tauri commands via scope system

sidecar_pattern.use_case: Offload CPU-intensive ASCII conversion to Rust sidecar process

tier1_webgpu.approach: Compute shader converts texture luminance to character index
tier1_webgpu.atlas: Pre-rendered character atlas as GPU texture (monospace font, all ASCII chars)
tier1_webgpu.pipeline: Source image → GPU texture → Luminance compute → Character atlas lookup → Output canvas

tier2_webgl.approach: Fragment shader with character atlas texture

tier3_canvas2d.approach: getImageData → luminance mapping → fillText per cell
tier3_canvas2d.use_case: Static images, low-res previews, maximum compatibility
tier3_canvas2d.optimization: Batch fillText calls, use offscreen canvas, throttle to 30fps

rust_sidecar.purpose: CPU-intensive image preprocessing, batch conversion, file I/O
rust_sidecar.pattern: image::DynamicImage → resize/grayscale → pixel luminance → char mapping → String

character_sets.custom: User-definable character ramp with luminance sorting

performance_optimizations: Web Worker for image processing (off main thread)
Adaptive resolution based on viewport size
Frame throttling with requestAnimationFrame + delta time
Spatial hashing for dirty region tracking
Character atlas caching (measure ink coverage once)

ascii_luminance_mapping.pattern: inkOf() measures glyph coverage by rendering to 1x1 canvas, sorting chars by ink density
ascii_luminance_mapping.code: ctx.fillText(glyph, CELL/2, CELL/2); const {data} = ctx.getImageData(0,0,CELL,CELL); let sum=0; for(let i=3;i<data.length;i+=4) sum+=data[i]??0; return sum/(255*CELL*CELL)

rust_image_to_ascii.pattern: Compute block size from aspect ratio, iterate pixels, map luminance to charset

webgpu_ascii_shader.pattern: Three.js TSL (Type-safe Shading Language) + WebGPU renderer, ASCII atlas texture lookup

community_verdict.sentiment_summary: Tauri v2 is the consensus choice for cross-platform desktop+mobile apps requiring native performance. ASCII rendering is best done via GPU shaders (WebGPU/WebGL) for real-time, with Rust sidecar for batch processing.
key_warnings: Canvas 2D fillText is too slow for real-time ASCII video (use WebGL/WebGPU)
Android WebView differs from desktop - test layout early
Tauri v2 ACL permissions must be explicitly configured or commands fail silently in release builds
WebGPU support is still limited on some Android devices - always provide WebGL fallback
key_endorsements: DavidHDev/canvas-ui is the most complete open-source ASCII rendering library (WebGL + WebGPU)
Tauri v2 sidecar pattern is ideal for offloading CPU-intensive image processing to Rust
Three-tier rendering (WebGPU → WebGL → Canvas2D) ensures maximum compatibility
Monospace font choice is critical for ASCII grid alignment - test with JetBrains Mono
